scope: FIRE Business App isolated candidates only
behavior: Agreements checks HTTP status and collection before replacing records.
Read failures display accessible alert with Retry and preserve existing rows; signed/awaiting/change counters and stale editor hidden on loading/error.
Detail refresh re-enters loading, clears selection and reloads current signature/change-request state.
Search miss says No matching agreements, while valid empty data says No agreements yet.
testLimits: Actual ContractsView/hooks/load/retry/detail-refresh with mocked GET; existing financial regression uses synthetic SQLite. No hosted/mobile/signature integration proof.
priorManifest: Historical review manifests preserved and do not seal newer source/review inputs.
